_note: Key set for the rows vm_info and vm actually return. Not a hand-picked power_state/id example. default_projection aliases are VM_DEFAULT_FIELDS in pyvergeos 1.2.7 and 1.6.1 (identical). The keys $key, name, machine, node_name, ram, cpu_cores, running, ha_group, is_snapshot and status were recorded from a live 26.1.8 client.vms.list() row (tests/unit/roles/test_rebalance_advisor_planner.py). snapshot_profile and tags are the two columns vm_info adds because the default summary omits them. boot_order is a real VM column the vm module asks for by name; the default summary does not include it (tests/live/verify-field-contract.yml). Other values are illustrative. Do not add power_state or id.
